# Clavis Encrypt 3.13.2

## 👋 When you uninstall

- If you uninstall Clavis on Windows (installer version), a short page opens in your browser. It reminds you that your encrypted files and vault stay on your PC and how to open them again, and asks why you uninstalled. Answering is optional and anonymous. The app itself still sends nothing.
- Updates and silent uninstalls don't open the page.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now), or download the new installer from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.
- **Microsoft Store:** the Store updates it automatically.
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
